theorem: Traceless Hermitian qubit involutions X=n.sigma and Z=m.sigma anticommute exactly when the Bloch columns Q=[n,m] lie on the Stiefel manifold V_2(R^3). Nearest joint factors therefore solve max tr(Q^T B). If B has full column rank, its rectangular polar factor Q*=B(B^T B)^(-1/2) is the unique global maximizer. The smallest eigenvalue of B^T B is the explicit transversality premise. ST212 is precisely the rank-one boundary where this premise fails and a circle of minimizers appears.
